collection.title: MODIS/Terra Snow Cover Monthly L3 Global 0.05Deg CMG V061

access: Earthdata Login (environment token); NSIDC cloud HTTPS download of each monthly file (1-2 MB) to a scratch dir, read with pyhdf, deleted at once (no OPeNDAP route listed in CMR for this collection)
regrid: mean of valid (0-100 percent) 0.05 degree cells in each 20 x 20 block (1 degree), kept if >= 200 of 400 valid
note: Raw granules are not kept; only the 1-degree monthly derivative is shipped. No trend statistic is computed in the build.
